channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from morningNewsSection1, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: DHS admits inflated noncitizen voter roll figures
item.description: The agency's claimed numbers of noncitizens on voter rolls were overstated, according to communications with states.

item.title: Voter ID measures on ballots in multiple states this year
item.description: At least six states will vote on voter ID proposals, marking a record number of such measures in a single year.

item.title: Country music icon Dolly Parton passes away at age 80
item.description: A celebrated country music star, Parton became one of the genre's most famous and beloved figures worldwide.

item.title: Canada hits back with retaliatory tariffs as U.S. trade tensions escalate
item.description: The response follows President Trump's 50% tariffs on many Canadian goods and threats of more after talks collapsed on Friday.
